text:
toni: quick UX thread — i'm re-reviewing the run-history compact row. the current arg-preview is hover-only and the chevron animation feels jumpy on mobile. thoughts on making it click-to-toggle with a persistent icon?

may: totally. hover-only is bad for touch. click-to-toggle with an aria-expanded state is cleaner. also suggest using a static ellipsis token … for truncation instead of three dots so it's consistent across fonts.

rui: agree on click toggle. accessibility nits: the expanded panel needs role=dialog or region with aria-modal=false, and focus trap shouldn't be enforced — keyboard users should be able to tab out. when it opens, move focus to the heading inside the panel. Escape should close and return focus to the toggle button.

tonI: small react prop thought — we should emit telemetry when users expand previews so we can see how often previews are used in dense timelines. if it's < 2% we might hide the affordance by default.

izzy: microcopy options for the button (compact space):
- "Preview"
- "Show value"
- "Inspect"
Which feels best? also prefer no punctuation in the single-word label for localization.

may: "Preview" is the cleanest. keep label <= 10 chars. for tooltip text (a11y only) use "Open argument preview for <arg>". That gives screen readers context without bloating UI.

rui: visual design: use token color -- interactive/quiet for the pill, and interactive/strong for the chevron when expanded. ensure 4.5:1 contrast for the chevron on hover/focus. no animated layout shifts when expanding; animate opacity only.

toni: sample CSS idea (pseudo):
```
.preview-panel { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 180ms ease, opacity 120ms ease; }
.preview-panel.open { max-height: 240px; opacity: 1; }
```
this avoids jumps but permits a smooth reveal.

izzy: copy variants to stash on the ticket: ["Preview", "Show value", "Inspect", "Value"] — i'll add localization notes: avoid verbs that imply network fetch.

tonI: QA checklist items: keyboard open/close, screen reader announce, return focus, mobile tap target >= 44px, no regression in run-history virtualization. i'll put those in the ticket.

design-bot: New ticket: #PL-2147 "Run-history: click-to-toggle arg preview + accessibility" https://go/redwood/PL-2147

may: one more UX idea: collapse large arrays/objects into a compact summary line like "object (3 keys)" and allow an inline expand to show the mini-json viewer. keeps rows tidy.

rui: good call. show type + size hint, e.g. "array (12)" or "object (5)". clicking the size hint opens the mini-json.

toni: next steps: izzy add copy variants + loc note to PL-2147, rui add a11y checklist, may to prototype click-to-toggle in the compact row mock, toni will wire telemetry. sync in 30 mins if needed.

izzy: lgtm, scheduling 15-min sync after lunch. :calendar:
